title: Prevented explicit company tickers from being replaced during peer expansion
points: Explicit valid tickers are now presented to the Router as a compact ticker-company-industry block and must remain in its executable plan, including when a competitor request expands to an industry peer set.
Ticker and industry metadata are checked against the canonical company inventory before lane execution, preventing adjacent ticker substitutions such as NATF being treated as NATM.
Canonical company identities now continue into the answer context so the Analyst does not guess a company name from its ticker symbol.
Stale market-price observations remain visible as row-level freshness notes but no longer label the whole answer with a global warning.
Inconsistent plans are returned to the Router for one corrected plan; runtime does not rewrite the company or manufacture a replacement peer universe.
Regression coverage now includes the National Foods competitor query and a deliberately inconsistent textile-peer plan.
